original_title: milet LIVE at Nippon Budokan 2026「Ray of Water」
overview: In February 2026, milet held a concert at the Nippon Budokan, her first performance there in three years. milet named this performance "Ray of Water" with the hope of "bringing a ray of hope to those who watch the live show." Various installations were used to transform the iconic Budokan stage into a fantastic space where light and water intersect and interact. The performance on February 14, 2026 was broadcast exclusively on TBS-1 with all songs uncut. Original behind-the-scenes footage from the program was also included.
title: milet LIVE at Nippon Budokan 2026「Ray of Water」

data.overview: In February 2026, milet held a concert at the Nippon Budokan, her first performance there in three years. milet named this performance "Ray of Water" with the hope of "bringing a ray of hope to those who watch the live show." Various installations were used to transform the iconic Budokan stage into a fantastic space where light and water intersect and interact. The performance on February 14, 2026 was broadcast exclusively on TBS-1 with all songs uncut. Original behind-the-scenes footage from the program was also included.
2026年2月，milet 在日本武道馆举行了演唱会，这是她时隔三年再次在该场馆登台演出。她将这次演出命名为“Ray of Water”，寓意是“为观看现场的人带去一束希望之光”。演出通过多种舞台装置，将这一标志性的武道馆空间打造成一个光与水交汇、相互作用的梦幻世界。2026年2月14日的演出在 TBS-1 独家播出，所有曲目均为无删减版本，同时还收录了节目原创的幕后花絮影像。
data.title: milet日本武道馆演唱会「Ray of Water」

data.overview: 하늘과 땅을 잇는 독보적인 음색, milet이 선사하는 빛과 물의 서사시!"  2026년 3월 6일과 7일 양일간, 일본 음악의 성지 **니폰 부도칸(Nippon Budokan)**에서 개최된 milet의 단독 라이브 'Ray of Water'의 실황이 공개된다. 자신의 데뷔 기념일에 맞춰 기획된 이번 공연은, 그녀의 음악 인생에서 가장 상징적인 곡인 'Ray of Water'를 중심으로 꾸며져 단순한 콘서트를 넘어 하나의 예술적인 파노라마를 선보였다.  특유의 허스키하면서도 맑은 고음이 부도칸의 웅장한 공간감을 가득 채우는 가운데, 물의 흐름을 형상화한 환상적인 무대 연출과 오케스트라가 어우러진 풍성한 사운드가 관객들을 압도한다.
data.title: 미레이 LIVE at Nippon Budokan 2026「Ray of Water」
